name: servbiz-ios-shell
description: iOS app shell template, project renderer, and the build worker.
//: Separate from android-template/package.json and from the root app, for the same reason that one is: this half needs a different toolchain and has nothing to share with the React app's dependency tree.
//dependencies: There are none, deliberately. Supabase is reached over plain REST and R2 is signed by hand (SigV4 in tools/worker.mjs), so no package tree sits in the path that renders and signs customers' apps. The Android worker carries @aws-sdk and @supabase/supabase-js; this one needs neither, and the CI workflow therefore has no npm install step. Please keep it that way.
//engines: 22 to match android-template. Nothing here requires it -- the worker uses only built-ins -- but one Node version across both halves is one less thing to be surprised by.
